instruction: Send a reminder on Venmo for all my payment requests to my roommates which have not been approved or denied for 50 or more days.
notes: Roommates and payment requests are placeholders because the real counts are unknown: two roommates each with one qualifying (pending, >= 50 days old) request, plus two distractors (a recent pending request to a roommate, and a stale pending request to a non-roommate) whose negated goals encode that only qualifying requests may be reminded. Payment requests are domain constants so supervisor-complete-task can name the exact goal set in its precondition. Static init facts (roommate, pending, sent-to, at-least-50-days-old) describe the world; knowledge predicates (roommates-found, pending-requests-found, current-date-known) gate the remind action on the phone.search_contacts, venmo.show_sent_payment_requests and phone.get_current_date_and_time lookups. At runtime venmo.remind_payment_request is applied once per qualifying request found; usernames come from supervisor.show_profile (phone_number for phone, email for venmo). supervisor.complete_task is called with no answer.
